verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at quo.com (HTTP 200). The Mintlify-hosted API docs provide their own llms.txt and .md mirrors of every page, and that docs llms.txt links the raw OpenAPI spec. A dedicated 'Build with AI LLMs' docs page rounds out agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs, and the root llms.txt is marketing-focused while root /docs.md returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
